heading: Short title
provision: Names the bill the Stop Insider Trading Act

heading: Restrictions on covered investments
provision: Bars a Member of Congress, spouse or dependent child from buying a covered investment, and requires public notice 7 to 14 days before a sale
law_amended: 5 U.S.C. chapter 131, new subchapter IV (sections 13151 and on)

heading: Requiring voters to provide photo identification
provision: Requires a valid photo ID to receive a ballot in person in an election for federal office; a voter without one may cast a provisional ballot
law_amended: Help America Vote Act of 2002, new section 303A (52 U.S.C. 21081 and on)
effective: As the section sets it; not read today
